title: Grusch approaches Knapp and Corbell at a bar at the SCU event

tellings.quote: What happened is we were in Rocket City, Alabama.

plain: David Grusch, the intelligence officer who in 2022 filed a whistleblower complaint about secret UFO work with the Intelligence Community Inspector General (the watchdog for US spy agencies), first approached the journalist George Knapp and the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell at a bar during a conference of UFO researchers in Rocket City, as Huntsville, Alabama, is called. Corbell tells Michels this as something he was there for, and he names the Stanford scientist Garry Nolan as part of the scene. If it happened this way, it is how Grusch's story first reached the reporters who later helped bring it out.
